1.why: All text uses a clean sans-serif typeface with adequate line spacing, though letter spacing appears standard rather than notably generous.

2.why: No italics or all-caps appear on any screen, and all copy is presented as short lines rather than dense blocks.

3.why: Content sits in a narrow single column with full-width fields and a large button that fits a mobile-sized viewport.

4.why: Instructions are single short sentences such as 'Confirm your account details before setting up payment security.'

5.why: Both fields display example values as placeholders (marcus@example.com, +15551234567), reinforced by the note to use the details shown in the placeholders.

6.why: Every screen contains only labels and one-sentence instructions; no long block of text appears anywhere.

7.why: No codes or secrets are displayed on any of the four screens and no copy affordance is visible.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative appears; the flow never progressed beyond the sign-in form.

9.why: There is no password field and no observable indicator of autofill or password-manager support, so this can neither be confirmed nor denied.

10.why: The 'Sign in to continue' heading, the 'Security centre · MFA enrolment' breadcrumb, and the large blue Continue button make the step and primary action prominent.

11.why: Each screen presents one form with a single Continue action and no competing calls to action.

12.why: After submission a banner states the request could not be completed and to try again, but it does not explain what actually happened.

13.why: The error banner explicitly invites retry and the entered values remain in the fields with no lockout, though no code reveal/hide/re-request controls are ever shown.

14.why: The error message is blame-free and says how to proceed ('Please try again'), but it does not state what the problem was.

15.why: No countdown, timer, or timeout warning appears on any screen, though code entry itself is never shown so its time allowance cannot be observed.
